exposure: Intrapartum referrals in primary midwife-led care births
intrapartum referrals in primary midwife-led care births
cohort: 789,795 births of women with low-risk pregnancies in primary midwife-led care at the onset of labor
finding: Despite an increase in intrapartum referrals, the cesarean section rate did not increase over the study period, while the use of pain relief and augmentation increased.
mod_finding: The caesarean section rate did not increase despite a rise in intrapartum referrals.
